change.before: "Istio CRDs not templated by default; Upgrade: kubectl apply -f manifests/charts/base/files/crd-all.gen.yaml or similar"
change.after: "Istio CRDs are templated by default in istio-base; Upgrade: helm upgrade istio-base; out-of-band kubectl install/upgrade of CRDs is no longer required"

consequence.statement: On upgrade to 1.24.0 the istio-base chart templates the Istio CRDs by default, the labels on the CRDs change to be consistent with other Helm-installed resources, and helm upgrade istio-base now safely upgrades CRDs that were previously installed with helm install istio-base or kubectl apply; nothing fails if the operator does nothing, and manual kubectl apply CRD installs/upgrades continue to work.
consequence.remediation: Optionally replace the previously documented out-of-band CRD upgrade (kubectl apply -f manifests/charts/base/files/crd-all.gen.yaml) with helm upgrade istio-base; environments that do not use Helm to install, template, or manage Istio resources may continue installing CRDs manually with kubectl apply.

assertion.statement: In Istio 1.24.0 the Istio CRDs are templated by default in the istio-base Helm chart, so CRDs can be installed and upgraded with `helm upgrade istio-base` (CRD labels change to match other Helm-installed resources), while CRDs previously installed or upgraded with `kubectl apply` can continue to be managed that way and are also safely upgradable via Helm from this release onward.
